functional_correctness.description: Measures whether the solution meets the specified requirements and behaves correctly for all expected inputs.

edge_case_handling.description: Evaluates how well the solution deals with edge cases, including unusual, extreme, or unexpected inputs.

efficiency.description: Assesses the time and space complexity of the solution, ensuring it performs well within given constraints.

robustness.description: Measures the ability of the solution to handle errors gracefully and maintain functionality under adverse conditions.

api_library_usage.description: Evaluates the appropriate use of APIs and libraries, ensuring they are leveraged correctly and efficiently.

readability.description: Assesses how easy the solution is to read and understand, including code structure, comments, and naming conventions.

maintainability.description: Evaluates how easy it is to modify and extend the solution in the future, considering code organization and modularity.

error_security_handling.description: Measures how well the solution safeguards against potential security vulnerabilities and errors that could lead to failures.
